title: Why Source Provenance Is Governance Infrastructure
question: How can an institution explain which evidence shaped a decision and find every affected use when that evidence changes?
expression: RN’s published essay for people who design, review or rely on institutional evidence records. Article six of Uncertainty Has an Owner, within Nervous System Aware Governance, begins with a hypothetical agency denial based on an AI summary whose citations conceal changes to the underlying evidence. RN distinguishes a source link from the longer record of how material was captured, changed, interpreted, reviewed and used. Her Provenance Spine connects eight steps: origin, capture, transformation, claim, review, decision, use and correction. A fourteen-field Decision Lineage Record turns that argument into a proposed working record, covering source versions and fragments, access restrictions, conflicting evidence, review authority, reasons for a decision, later reuse and responsibility for corrections.
